# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/postgres-backup-restore-checker/security/advisories/new) to share a description, reproduction steps, and potential impact. This repository must have private vulnerability reporting enabled for the form to be available. If the form is unavailable, open an issue asking for a private reporting channel and do not include vulnerability details there. Avoid sharing production backups, credentials, or unrelated personal data. Reports will be reviewed and next steps will be coordinated through the advisory.
